bioconda.name: bioconductor-ggtree
bioconda.summary: an R package for visualization of tree and annotation data

biotools.summary: Offers a set of 'autoplot' methods to visualize tree-like structures (e.g., hierarchical clustering and classification/regression trees) using 'ggtree'. You can adjust graphical parameters using grammar of graphic syntax and integrate external data to the tree.
